\begin{table*}[t]
\centering
\caption{What the training-free methods we re-measure actually report.
$\bullet$ reported, $\circ$ not reported. Every method specifies its own
configuration and sweeps it, so the field is careful here. Not one releases
per-episode outcomes or tests a difference for significance, which is what our
protocol adds. The selection constraint is the column the specifications leave
open, and the two prescriptions on record contradict each other.}
\label{tab:reporting}
\footnotesize
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{5pt}
\begin{tabular}{@{}lllccccc@{}}
\toprule
& & & & Setting & Per-task & Per-episode & Paired \\
Method & Candidate scope & Selection constraint & Default setting & swept & split & records & test \\
\midrule
ShortGPT~\cite{shortgpt}      & all layers          & none, top-$n$ by BI            & $25\%$ of $40$          & $\bullet$ & $\circ^{\dag}$ & $\circ$ & $\circ$ \\
EfficientVLA~\cite{efficientvla} & all layers       & none, ``non-contiguous''       & $L{=}28/22$, $T{=}112/56$ & $\bullet$ & $\bullet$ & $\circ$ & $\circ$ \\
FastV~\cite{fastv}            & start layer $K$     & ---$^{\ddag}$                  & $R \in \{50,75,90\}\%$  & $\bullet$ & $\bullet$ & $\circ$ & $\circ$ \\
VLA-Cache~\cite{vlacache}     & layer-adaptive      & $\tau_{\text{task}}{=}0.5$     & $\tau{=}0.996$, $k{=}100$ & $\bullet$ & $\bullet$ & $\circ$ & $\circ$ \\
VLA-Pruner~\cite{vlapruner}   & token budget        & semantic and action, dual      & $50/75/87.5\%$          & $\bullet$ & $\bullet$ & $\circ$ & $\circ$ \\
\midrule
Gromov et al.~\cite{gromov}$^{\S}$ & deepest layers only & contiguous, final layer kept & sweep over depth    & $\bullet$ & $\circ^{\dag}$ & $\circ$ & $\circ$ \\

{\footnotesize $^{\dag}$Reports per benchmark rather than per task, being an
